evidence.section: Cryopreservation of PBMC and ex-vivo IFN-γ ELISpot
evidence.quote: IFN-γ ELISpots were performed ex-vivo at screening and weeks 1,2,4,12, and 24 post-vaccination as previously described [ 29 ].

Gene Expression Analysis.readouts: gene expression levels measured on Illumina expression beadchips

evidence.quote: Amplified RNA (750ng per array) was hybridized to the Illumina HumanHT-12 version 4 expression beadchip according to manufacturer’s instructions.

Quantitative PCR.standard_technique_name: real time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction
Quantitative PCR.readouts: mRNA expression levels as copy number normalized to HPRT

evidence.quote: cDNA was stored at -20°C until qPCR was performed, using the Roche LightCycler® 480 and Quantitect mastermix (Qiagen).

Flow cytometry.readouts: Treg frequencies and TLR1 surface fluorescence intensity on live cells

evidence.quote: A FACSCalibur (Becton Dickinson) was used for flow cytometry event collection and events were analysed using FlowJo (Tree Star Inc.).

Western blot.readouts: HMGB1 protein detected in supernatants over time after stimulation

evidence.quote: The membrane was incubated sequentially for 1 hour with PBS with 3% BSA alone, primary antibody (mouse anti-human HMGB1, Biolegend, UK) and finally secondary antibody (Alkaline Phosphatase-AffiniPure Donkey Anti-Mouse IgG, Stratech Scientific Limited).
